## Support Ticket Structured Data Extraction with Clocked.ai

### How it works

This workflow manually processes a support ticket using Clocked.ai to extract structured information. It generates a unique request ID, sends the ticket and extraction schema to the Clocked.ai API, converts the response to binary, and writes the output to a file.

### Setup steps

- Configure the support ticket text and JSON extraction schema.
- Set up Clocked.ai API authentication and the POST endpoint: `https://clocked.rezolve.ai/clocked/extract`.
- Ensure the unique ID generator provides an idempotency key for each request.
- Configure the binary conversion and output file path.
- Execute the workflow and verify the extracted data and saved file.

### Customization

Modify the extraction schema to capture ticket details, affected applications, troubleshooting steps, and callback requirements. Add validation, error handling, human review, or ticketing system integration as needed.

## Manual Input + Normalization

Provide the support ticket text and extraction rules. Normalize the input while preserving the original ticket content for traceability.

## Clocked Extract

Extract structured ticket details using https://clocked.rezolve.ai/extract

## Export Data Handling

Convert the JSON response the Binary and persist the same on disk
